scope: New current-view and native read controls on an already admitted two-person fixture. No enrollment-function, info, installed, product-call or final-head acceptance replay.
fixture: Use actual stopped creator A after the independently observed cold Bob operation. Reopen IN PLACE, without passing an original private key, generating a key, changing selection or copying daemon state. Public creation/completion receipts identify the exact two people and network.

cases.name: current_persons_equal_exact_admitted_person_leases_and_reads_preserve_state
assert: Exact four-field person rows, sorted unique by stable person key, equal the two independently admitted original people, labels, current person-lease IDs and finite deadlines resolved from retained public catalog
GET persons/policy/planning/catalog does not commit clock, admission, signer, signature, event or provider changes; actual provider availability stays separate from usable cached public authority

cases.name: current_policy_returns_original_signed_bytes_and_absent_Bob_policy_is_not_fabricated
assert: Alice's policy response is exactly statement_id plus canonical Base64 of the ORIGINAL retained signed current statement, independently matching its ds_ and policy owner
Bob is admitted but has not signed a policy; GET for that exact canonical encoded key returns404 not_found without a fabricated legacy policy or mutation

cases.name: native_agents_and_access_read_current_DEC_views_without_signing_or_legacy_policy_failure
assert: Public help-bound agents --network ID --json succeeds with a directory object; access show --network ID --person exact Alice label succeeds with nonempty output
No new approval, signature, provider selection, authority, clock or event follows; reads preserve actual identity and current usable public membership even when a signer is unavailable
Positive commands establish observable native DEC read behavior, not packet-level tracing of their internal HTTP calls or live agents/capabilities

stop_rule: Freeze executable and exact supported binary/source before execution. Retain first failure; repeat only failed and unevaluated cases. No private key extraction and no earlier native A or six-case function is called.
